description: This file defines a Java interface named ContentImageGet which extends the ImageGet interface. It declares methods related to retrieving images and image names in the context of a content management system, likely for use within a larger e-commerce or CMS application.

classes.name: ContentImageGet
classes.description: Java interface providing methods for retrieving images and image names associated with a content management system, extending the ImageGet interface.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Retrieves an image file given merchant store code, image name, and content type.

methods.name: getImageNames
methods.description: Retrieves a list of image names for a given merchant store code and content type.
